description: Downloads one Freesound sound (its HQ MP3 preview, ~128 kbps — plenty for SFX/ambience) into the project's media pool as a virtual file at the Library root (name `freesound-<id>.mp3`). Asynchronous: the first call accepts the download and returns its state; CALL AGAIN with the same arguments to poll — state becomes 'done' with the asset's mediaRef, ready for add_clips onto an audio track. Three files stream at a time and the rest wait their turn, shared with stock video, so state 'queued' is normal and needs no action but polling.

token.description: The session token `connect` returned. Pass it on every call — it says which browser to drive.

name: download_sound
